title: Lacks functionality
body:
1) Please make nutrition tracking more functional and cross-relatable. Currently we can add data separately (calories consumed does not even exist), but why not add meal segments? By logging a whole meal, all data can just be categorised by itself. I believe many would find this very useful to not log meals manually on paper or use other apps.

2) Mindfulness section should be improved. You can add mindful minutes, but why not create a special mindfulness interface where you can set a timer (like pomodoro) and track this time automatically to show you how productive you are.

App has great potential but needs a lot of improvement in categories with manual data input.
